An events company deploys a web application on Amazon EKS. The application uses an Amazon DynamoDB table provisioned with 1,000 read capacity units (RCUs) and 500 write capacity units (WCUs). The application performs eventually consistent reads. Traffic is usually low but occasionally increases significantly. During these sudden increases, DynamoDB returns throttling errors, causing error pages to appear to users. What should a solutions architect do to reduce these errors?
Change the DynamoDB table to on-demand capacity mode.
Create a DynamoDB read replica to horizontally scale read traffic.
Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for 1,000 RCUs and 500 WCUs.
Configure the application to use strongly consistent reads for DynamoDB queries.

A company has a service that generates event data. The company wants to process the event data on AWS as it arrives. The data is written in a specific order, and that order must be maintained throughout processing. The company wants to minimize operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do?
Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to hold the messages. Configure an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send notifications containing the payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber.
Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold the messages. Configure an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send notifications containing the payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber.

A company receives 10 TB of instrumentation data each day from multiple machines at a single factory. The data consists of JSON files stored on a storage area network (SAN) in the factory's on-premises data center. The company wants to send the data to Amazon S3, where several other systems can access it for critical near-real-time analytics. Secure transfer is important because the data is sensitive. Which solution provides the MOST reliable data transfer?
AWS DataSync over the public internet
AWS DataSync over AWS Direct Connect
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over the public internet
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over AWS Direct Connect

A company wants to reduce the cost of its existing three-tier web architecture. Web, application, and database servers run on Amazon EC2 instances in development, testing, and production environments. Average CPU utilization is 30% during peak hours and 10% during off-peak hours. Production instances run 24 hours a day. Development and testing instances run at least 8 hours a day. The company plans to automate stopping development and testing instances when they are not in use. Which EC2 purchasing solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Use Spot Instances for production. Use Reserved Instances for development and testing.
Use Reserved Instances for production. Use On-Demand Instances for development and testing.
Use Spot blocks for production. Use Reserved Instances for development and testing.
Use On-Demand Instances for production. Use Spot blocks for development and testing.

A company has created an image analysis application that lets users upload photos and add frames to them. Users upload images and metadata specifying which frames to add. The application uses a single Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon DynamoDB to store metadata. The application is growing in popularity, and the company expects concurrent user counts to vary significantly by time of day and day of the week. The company must ensure that the application scales to meet the growing user base's needs. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store photos and metadata in DynamoDB.
Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to process the photos and store photos and metadata.
Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store photos in Amazon S3. Continue using DynamoDB for metadata.
Increase the number of EC2 instances to three. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to store photos and metadata.

A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances and needs a disaster recovery (DR) solution. The recovery time objective (RTO) must be less than 4 hours. The DR solution must use as few AWS resources as possible during normal operations. Which solution meets these requirements MOST operationally efficiently?

Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) to back up the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to a secondary AWS Region. Use AWS Lambda and custom scripts to automate infrastructure deployment in the secondary Region.
Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) to back up the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to a secondary AWS Region. Use AWS CloudFormation to automate infrastructure deployment in the secondary Region.
Launch EC2 instances in a secondary AWS Region. Keep the instances in the secondary Region active at all times.
Launch EC2 instances in a secondary Availability Zone. Keep the instances in that Availability Zone active at all times.

A company has more than 5 TB of file data on an on-premises Windows file server. Users and applications interact with the data daily. The company is migrating its Windows workloads to AWS. During the migration, it needs low-latency access to file storage both on AWS and on premises. The solution must minimize operational overhead and avoid significant changes to existing file access patterns. The company connects to AWS through an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. What should a solutions architect do?
Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Move the on-premises file data to FSx for Windows File Server. Reconfigure workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS.
Deploy and configure Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to S3 File Gateway. Reconfigure on-premises and cloud workloads to use S3 File Gateway.

Deploy and configure Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to Amazon S3. Reconfigure workloads to use either Amazon S3 directly or S3 File Gateway, depending on each workload's location.

Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Deploy and configure Amazon FSx File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to FSx File Gateway. Configure cloud workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS and on-premises workloads to use FSx File Gateway.

A financial company hosts a web application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway Regional API endpoint to let users retrieve current stock prices. The security team notices an increase in API requests and is concerned that an HTTP flood attack could take the application offline. A solutions architect must protect the application from such attacks. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint with a maximum TTL of 24 hours.
Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage.
Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the Count metric and alert the security team when a predefined rate is reached.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint. Create an AWS Lambda function that blocks requests from IP addresses exceeding a predefined rate.

A company is building a gaming system that must send distinct events simultaneously to separate leaderboard, matchmaking, and authentication services. The company needs an AWS event-driven system that guarantees event ordering. Which solution meets these requirements?
Amazon EventBridge event bus
Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic
Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic
Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue

A company runs a public three-tier web application in a VPC on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. EC2 instances in private subnets need to communicate with a license server over the internet. The company needs a managed solution that minimizes operational maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?
Configure a NAT instance in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route to the NAT instance.
Configure a NAT instance in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route to the NAT instance.
Configure a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route to the NAT gateway.
Provision a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route to the NAT gateway.

A weather startup has a custom web application that sells weather data online. The company stores its data in Amazon DynamoDB and wants a new service that alerts the managers of four internal teams whenever a new weather event is recorded. The new service must not affect the current application's performance. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Use DynamoDB transactions to write new event data to the table. Configure the transactions to notify the internal teams.
Have the current application publish messages to four Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Have each team subscribe to one topic.
Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. Use a trigger to publish to a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that the teams can subscribe to.

Add a custom attribute to each record to mark new items. Write a cron job that scans the table every minute for new items and notifies an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue that the teams can subscribe to.

A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to make an existing application highly available and resilient. The current application runs in the company's data center. An unexpected power outage recently caused the database server to crash and the application to lose data. The company needs a solution without any single point of failure that can scale to meet user demand. Which solution meets these requirements?
Deploy application servers on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ configuration.
Deploy application servers on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. Deploy the database on an EC2 instance and enable EC2 automatic recovery.

Deploy application servers on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance with a read replica in a single Availability Zone. Promote the read replica if the primary DB instance fails.

Deploy application servers on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Deploy primary and secondary database servers on EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach for shared storage between the instances.

A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer with sticky sessions enabled. The web servers currently host user session state. The company wants high availability and must avoid losing user session state if a web server fails. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instances to store session data. Update the application to store session state in ElastiCache for Memcached.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to store session state. Update the application to store session state in ElastiCache for Redis.
Use AWS Storage Gateway cached volumes to store session data. Update the application to store session state on the cached volumes.
Use Amazon RDS to store session state. Update the application to store session state in Amazon RDS.

A company stores high-resolution pictures in an Amazon S3 bucket. To minimize application changes, the company stores each picture as the latest version of an S3 object. The company needs to retain only the two most recent versions of each picture. The S3 bucket is a major expense, and the company wants to reduce costs. Which solution reduces S3 costs with the LEAST operational overhead?
Use S3 Lifecycle to delete old object versions and retain the two most recent versions.
Use an AWS Lambda function to check for old versions and delete all except the two most recent versions.
Use S3 Batch Operations jobs to delete noncurrent object versions and retain only the two most recent versions.
Disable versioning on the S3 bucket and retain the two most recent versions.

A solutions architect is creating a data processing job that runs once a day and can take up to 2 hours to complete. If the job is interrupted, it must restart from the beginning. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?
Create a script that runs locally on an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance and is triggered by a cron job.
Create an AWS Lambda function triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Fargate task triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.
Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task running on Amazon EC2 and triggered by an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event.

A company stores a large number of image files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Images must be readily available for the first 180 days and are rarely accessed for the next 180 days. After 360 days, images must be archived but remain immediately available on request. After 5 years, only auditors access the images, and they must be able to retrieve them within 12 hours. Images must not be lost. Developers will use S3 Standard for the first 180 days and need to configure S3 Lifecycle rules. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 days.
Transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
Transition objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
Transition objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 180 days, S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 360 days, and S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 years.
A company wants to analyze and troubleshoot access denied and unauthorized errors related to IAM permissions. AWS CloudTrail is enabled. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST effort?
Use AWS Glue and write custom scripts to query CloudTrail logs for errors.
Use AWS Batch and write custom scripts to query CloudTrail logs for errors.
Use Amazon Athena queries to search CloudTrail logs and identify errors.
Use Amazon QuickSight to search CloudTrail logs. Create dashboards to identify errors.

A company's website handles millions of requests each day, and the number is growing. A solutions architect needs to improve the web application's response time and determines that latency must be reduced when retrieving product details from an Amazon DynamoDB table. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Set up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Route all read requests through DAX.
Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Redis between the DynamoDB table and the web application. Route all read requests through Redis.
Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached between the DynamoDB table and the web application. Route all read requests through Memcached.
Set up Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. Use AWS Lambda to read from the table and populate Amazon ElastiCache. Route all read requests through ElastiCache.

A company has an organization in AWS Organizations with all features enabled. The company requires auditing of all API calls and sign-ins in every existing and new AWS account. It needs a managed solution that avoids extra work and minimizes costs. The company also needs to know when any account does not comply with the AWS Foundational Security Best Practices (FSBP) standard. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Deploy an AWS Control Tower environment in the Organizations management account. Enable AWS Security Hub and AWS Control Tower Account Factory in the environment.
Deploy an AWS Control Tower environment in a dedicated Organizations member account. Enable AWS Security Hub and AWS Control Tower Account Factory in the environment.
Build a multi-account landing zone (MALZ) using AWS Managed Services (AMS) Accelerate. Submit a request for change (RFC) to self-provision Amazon GuardDuty in the MALZ.
Build a multi-account landing zone (MALZ) using AWS Managed Services (AMS) Accelerate. Submit a request for change (RFC) to self-provision AWS Security Hub in the MALZ.

A company's software development team needs an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ cluster as the backend for an on-premises desktop client. The desktop client must connect directly to the RDS cluster. Developers must be able to connect through the client while in the office. Which solution provides the required connectivity MOST securely?
Create a VPC with two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
Create a VPC with two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
Create a VPC with two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use the RDS security group to allow the office IP address range to access the cluster.
Create a VPC with two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Create a cluster user for each developer. Use the RDS security group to allow those users to access the cluster.
